objective: Search trading policies by conditional net log growth, without requiring superior average probability scores
holdout: October-December2025 remains sealed; all results here are development diagnostics
selection: One contract per event per policy; largest absolute past move for momentum/reversal; highest midpoint satisfying threshold for favorite/longshot. Ticker breaks ties. Signal input excludes outcomes and future candles. Momentum/reversal require midpoint0.05..0.95.
orders: One conditional contract. Limit fixed at signal-side ask plus scenario slippage, capped0.99. At exact later entry hour buy only if later side ask plus slippage is within that limit. No carried quotes, candle highs/lows or volume-based assumed fills.
exits: Sell at exact scheduled later side bid less slippage, with sale fees; if no valid later quote or market closed, hold to actual settlement. Settlement-only is separately registered. Future quotes cannot choose the entry or exit policy.
fees: Explicit assumed0.07*p*(1-p) taker schedule with cent-rounded balance debit on each separate unit order; not verified contemporaneous2025 fee history. Both entry and quoted exit charged; settlement has no fee.
execution_limit: Candle endpoints do not prove depth, quote age, historical public receipt or actual fills. Outcomes are conditional screens only. No historical maker fills inferred.
monthly_selection: March-September monthly freezes, expanding earlier dates; use only positions exited/settled before month start. Choose largest costed mean daily log growth minus two standard errors of seven-day block sums among candidates with30trade days; require positive criterion and stress mean growth>0. All criteria use training only; otherwise cash. No winner chosen by validation PnL.
uncertainty: Final development comparisons cluster all cities by UTC outcome/release day, use shared circular7day bootstrap and familywise maximum statistic over all registered candidates and scenarios. This is a diagnostic, not holdout promotion.
